skill.name: free-tool-strategy
skill.description: Plan and evaluate free tools that generate leads, attract organic traffic, and build brand awareness.
skill.summary: Create a practical free-tool strategy with audience fit, SEO value, lead capture, promotion, and measurement.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: No malicious intent or executable behavior was found in the reviewed skill. The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences and ordinary marketing strategy language.

The cited text discusses UTM parameters for marketing attribution. It does not request system information or host reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Teams often invest in free tools without clear audience fit, SEO demand, or lead capture logic. This skill turns a tool idea into a structured growth plan with metrics and launch steps.
actual_capabilities: Frames free tool ideas around audience pain points, buyer fit, and business goals.
Compares calculators, generators, analyzers, validators, resource libraries, and educational tools.
Evaluates SEO opportunity, lead quality, build feasibility, maintenance burden, and promotion options.
Defines lead capture approaches, follow-up paths, success metrics, and attribution needs.
Produces a tool strategy document with concept, audience, build approach, metrics, promotion, and timeline.
limitations: It does not run keyword research tools or fetch live search volume data by itself.
It does not build or deploy the free tool implementation.
It depends on accurate business, audience, budget, and resource inputs from the user.
It does not replace legal, privacy, analytics, or security review before launch.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Free Tool Ideas
use_cases.description: Score several tool concepts by demand, buyer fit, uniqueness, feasibility, and promotion potential.

use_cases.title: Plan a Lead Capture Flow
use_cases.description: Choose between gated, partially gated, optional capture, and ungated models for a planned tool.

use_cases.title: Scope a Build Plan
use_cases.description: Define an MVP, build approach, timeline, maintenance needs, launch channels, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a Tool Idea
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a single early idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this free tool idea for my business: [idea]. My product is [product], my audience is [audience], and my goal is [goal].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Three Concepts
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these three free tool ideas: [idea 1], [idea 2], and [idea 3]. Score each by search demand, buyer fit, uniqueness, build effort, and lead quality.

prompt_templates.title: Design the Lead Capture Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a lead capture strategy for [tool concept]. Include gating choice, form fields, result delivery, follow-up emails, and qualification signals.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Full Launch Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a complete free tool strategy for [business]. Include concept, audience, SEO plan, MVP scope, build approach, success metrics, attribution, launch channels, and timeline.

output_examples.input: A B2B SaaS team wants a free readiness assessment to generate qualified pipeline.
output_examples.output: A strategy document that defines the assessment concept, buyer audience, partial gating model, SEO targets, MVP scope, nurture path, and launch metrics.

output_examples.input: An agency has five free calculator ideas and needs to choose one for the next quarter.
output: A ranked scorecard for all five concepts.
A recommendation with reasoning tied to lead quality, search demand, effort, and maintenance.
A short MVP scope and promotion plan for the top concept.

output_examples.input: A developer tools company wants a technical playground that supports SEO and product education.
output_examples.output: A plan covering the target user, core interaction, crawlable content, product path, launch channels, and measurement framework.

best_practices: Start with a real audience problem before choosing the tool format.
Keep the first version focused on one valuable outcome and one clear conversion path.
Measure usage, lead quality, pipeline influence, SEO growth, and maintenance cost together.
anti_patterns: Choosing a tool idea only because it is easy to build.
Gating the entire experience before users see enough value.
Launching without attribution, follow-up, or a plan to improve the tool after release.

faq.question: What type of free tool does this skill help plan?
faq.answer: It covers calculators, generators, analyzers, validators, resource libraries, and interactive educational tools.

faq.question: Does it provide live keyword search volume?
faq.answer: No. It helps plan keyword strategy, but users should verify search volume with SEO tools.

faq.question: Can it help decide whether to gate a tool?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares full gating, partial gating, optional capture, and ungated models.

faq.question: Is this only for SaaS companies?
faq.answer: No. It also supports agencies, ecommerce teams, developer tools, finance teams, and other service businesses.

faq.question: Can it create a build specification?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline MVP scope, core features, integrations, data needs, analytics, and launch phases.

faq.question: What inputs improve the output quality?
faq.answer: Provide the product, audience, goals, available resources, budget, timeline, and any existing tool ideas.
